description: USE THIS when the human says yes to a specific item. Creates the order and returns pay_url plus a ready-to-say sentence. It never charges a card: the human opens pay_url and approves payment themselves. Say the returned line to the human verbatim. Stock hold: the item is reserved for 24 hours after create_order; if payment is not approved within 24 hours the order auto-cancels and the hold is released. Payment facts: PayPal Business account, PayPal balance / debit card / credit card (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover); a PayPal account is NOT required; USD; the total already includes US duty, shipping and clearance. Never ask for card numbers, CVV or expiry, and never pay on the human's behalf. Full facts: GET /api/payment.json.

idempotency_key.description: same key returns the same open order

test.description: true = dry run, no stock taken, no email sent
